adjudication.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#execute the call to poll_feed is gated by `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? && SiteSetting.feed_polling_url.present? && SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). In spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb, the example `it "requires embed_by_username"` only stubs `embed_by_username` to nil, but does not stub `feed_polling_enabled?` to true nor `feed_polling_url` to a present value. Given the defaults added in site_settings.yml (`feed_polling_enabled: false`, `feed_polling_url: ''`), this test would pass even if the `embed_by_username.present?` guard were removed, so it doesn’t actually verify that guard’s effect.
